scoring_justification: Using hidden paper-reported values as reference, agent's computed activation energies and bond orders are compared within tolerances; trend (activation energies for Fe@H1-6 > C(N) and Fe@H7 < C(N)) is recomputed from the agent's own values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold activation energies and C5-N Mayer bond orders for all eight systems
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 3 (energy barriers) and Table 4 (Mayer bond orders)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted verbatim from the paper's tables
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are direct reproductions of the paper's reported quantities; used as reference for tolerance checking.

outputs.description: CSV file with the activation energy of the rate-determining step and the C5–N Mayer bond order for each system (C(N) and Fe@H1 to Fe@H7).
